Alice M: Starting deploy for release v3.14 — feature flag toggle plan for `gen-inference-v2`. Change window 22:30-23:30 UTC. tagging @Ben R @Carol S for ops.
DeployBot: Deploy queued: canary replica -> running smoke checks. Canary ticket 1745555555.
Ben R: Plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% with waits of ~5m/10m/20m/20m. Watch p99 latency, error rate, and token-cost delta. If p99 > 200ms OR errors increase by +10% -> pause and rollback.
Carol S: Adding infra checklist: pin model to `r20260320`, pre-warm KV cache, disable cache-compact during ramp, and ensure autoscaler min replicas=3. Release notes link: https://confluence/redwood/releases/v3.14
Alice M: Kicking off canary now. DeployBot, enable flag for cohort `canary-1`.
DeployBot: Flag `gen-inference-v2` enabled for cohort `canary-1` (1% traffic). Canary started on inference-rt-canary-03. Logs: /logs/1745555555
Dave K: Observed a small latency bump on canary-03 — p50 +15ms, p95 +60ms, p99 unchanged. Errors 0. No suspicious stack traces. Proceed to 5% in 5m?
Ben R: :thumbsup: proceed. I'll start metric watches and set alerts for surge.
DeployBot: Flag increased to 5% at 1745555600.
Elaine (PM): Heads up — customer X is on rotation today; if we see >0.5% user-facing failures we stop and notify them.
Carol S: Operational note: fallback is pinned to `r20260228`. Rollback command (manual): `/deploybot flag disable gen-inference-v2 --all`. Documented in runbook.
Ben R: At the 20% step we'll run a quick smoke eval (100 prompts) vs baseline. Failure criteria: avg Rouge-L drop > 0.03 OR hallucination rate +5% -> rollback.
Alice M: We're at 20% now. Starting smoke eval job: `smoke-1745555640`.
DeployBot: Smoke eval completed: Rouge-L delta -0.005, hallucination +1.2%. No blocking regressions.
Dave K: No errors surfaced in logs. Token unit cost delta +2.1% — within expectations. Proceeding to 60%.
DeployBot: Flag moved to 60% at 1745555700.
Ben R: At 60% keep a close eye on p99 and the error budget. New trigger: if customer X sees >0.2% failures OR token cost > +10% -> immediate rollback.
Alice M: Traffic looks stable. Scheduling final 100% push at 23:10 UTC if no alerts.
DeployBot: Final enable to 100% scheduled at 1745556000. Cancelable with `/deploybot schedule cancel 1745556000`.
Elaine (PM): Quick reminder to update the user-facing release notes and internal changelog after the cut — include migration tips for cache settings.
Alice M: Thanks all — standing by. If anyone sees red, call me directly. Going to grab a quick coffee ☕
notes: This thread records a controlled feature-flag ramp for a model change: includes pinning, rollback commands, smoke eval criteria, metric thresholds, and a scheduled final push.
